title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Copilot video creation in Video Hub, billed in Copilot Credits
summary: The briefing's billing, access requirements and preview limitations are supported, and it correctly distinguishes the roadmap targets from Microsoft's tenant notice. The spending-policy route stops at the limits page rather than the budget control; Microsoft's linked video-creation support article also describes a different workflow and should be distinguished from the notice.

claims.claim: Copilot brings agentic video creation to Clipchamp Video Hub.
claims.quote: Copilot brings agentic video creation to Clipchamp Video Hub.

claims.claim: Users can generate, edit and refine videos from prompts grounded in documents or Work IQ context.
claims.quote: Users can generate, edit, and refine videos from prompts—grounded in explicit documents or implicit WorkIQ knowledge.

claims.claim: A prompt can specify topic, audience, tone and length.
claims.quote: Create from a prompt. Describe the topic, audience, tone and length, or pick a starter prompt.

claims.quote: Ask for changes like "Use a more formal tone", "Make it shorter", "Localize this into Japanese" or "Update the title."

claims.where: What's changing; Scope; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The notice directs users to Video Hub, Create video, prompt, preview and refine, then Export as MP4.
claims.quote: Go to Create video in the left menu- Describe the video, and add files if needed.- Preview the video, refine it.- Select Export to save it as an MP4.
claims.fix: Add to What's changing: 'The support article linked from Learn's billing overview describes Clipchamp Home and further editing in the Clipchamp editor, unlike the Video Hub conversational preview in MC1560920; this briefing follows the notice for this update.' Cite https://support.microsoft.com/clipchamp/how-to-create-video-with-copilot, which says 'To keep working on your video, open it in Clipchamp' and 'The video editor opens in a new browser tab'.
